scope: A placement-policy crosswalk for the legacy Texas P0 inventory. Archetypes are reusable shapes from the shared 3D contract; this file neither creates a placement nor asserts that a raw source, curated database, or Texas demo artifact exists.
illustrative_wording_policy: The legacy word 'illustrative' is not a truth label. A stated analytical alternative is hypothetical only when a server artifact explicitly says so; an asset without the required evidence is unavailable.

entries.truth_label_policy: Synthetic only when placed from the validated ACTIVSg2000 artifact. It is not real ERCOT connectivity; without an accepted placement artifact it is unavailable.

Source-supported only after an accepted NTAD-derived placement preserves source, vintage, geometry, and coverage. The current P0 record is unavailable, so no placement may claim source support.
No approved Texas P0 facility source is inventoried. A placement is unavailable unless a later approved, provenance-preserving source artifact supplies it.

A proposal can be hypothetical only when a server artifact explicitly identifies it as an analytical alternative and preserves its limitations. It must never imply a licensed, permitted, or sited reactor; otherwise it is unavailable.
